text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: No ntab implementation exists in the current build; this is downstream of the still-deferred reference-resolution proposal. Retain P3. Exact-support validation, explicit missingness and contributor lineage remain sound requirements. On reactivation specify sample versus population variance, minimum contributors and numerical stability, and prove both batched IO and bounded memory against independent scalar oracles. Group summaries are descriptive reductions, not automatically valid independent subjects for group inference. Do not introduce a parallel relational/grouping engine.
